240-574-1251-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-1251-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4460-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.

Resolve the Evereth ability.

If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
